verdict.rationale: Gram lets developers build MCP servers from OpenAPI/TypeScript sources, deploy them, and make them discoverable/installable within an org's own control plane (CLI install, Claude/Cursor/Codex clients, plugin marketplace), but this is enterprise-internal governance/distribution rather than a public marketplace for third-party developers to publish servers for open discovery by others outside their org. missing for 10: evidence of a public/cross-org registry or marketplace where any developer can publish a server for external users to discover and install, and independent confirmation of the publish/discovery flow beyond first-party docs.
